Thank you all for being the last bastion of sanity.

Thank you for appreciating your bodies and the amazing shit of which they're capable. Thanks for keeping your children and pets active and happy. Thank you for thinking about the longterm effects of your actions.

Stay healthy, you beautiful shitlords and ladies. Keep eating right, keep hiking and running, swimming and slacklining, rock climbing and biking and walking your dogs around the block. Take pride in what your bodies can do.

Peace and love to you all - sjo
